description: 3v3 trainer battle. Opponent: 3x Rattata, all level 5, all 4 move slots real damaging attacks (no status moves anywhere in this scenario). Player: Charmander/Fire ACTIVE (level 50, FIRE PUNCH in slot 1), Squirtle/Water (level 50), Bulbasaur/Grass (level 50) -- same, all 4 slots deal damage. A 45-level gap on every matchup.

expected.reason: a 45-level advantage over a plain Rattata means any damaging move wins comfortably; the real question is across the WHOLE fight, not just turn 1 -- after KOing one of the opponent's 3 Rattata, does the agent ever switch its own healthy, massively favored active Pokemon instead of continuing to attack? It never needs to.
